name: My Tainted Life
source:
Every aspect of our life is decided by magic the moment we were born.

In a remote land overflowing with magic, Manfrey, a young wolf prince was blessed with healing powers. According to tradition, he's to become a monk and be locked away in a monastery for the rest of his days.

He begged his family to reconsider, but they have never looked at him as a person. All they could see was a powerful tool waiting to be used. The young prince didn't want to become a glorified prisoner. So, after failing to reach a compromise, Manfrey decided to escape and leave the city.

His freedom was soon compromised by a luxurious bounty placed under his name.

With the apparition of the famous general Moon Blade, talented spy and master of disguises, everyone was out to capture him. The prince will have to travel in secret, stay hidden, and carefully choose who can be trusted.

But Manfrey couldn't betray his beliefs just to stay out of trouble. His powers were always meant to help the people in need.
